disagreements.a: PowerPyx and KeenGamer count potentially 1: Positive Mental Attitude, whose first meditation can only be done in Chapter 1. [S3][S5]
disagreements.b: This guide flags 13 one-time moments, because each can only be done when it appears and there is no mission replay. [S3]
disagreements.call: Both are right at different strictness: only 1 can lock the platinum, but all 13 need doing when they appear.

disagreements.a: The official trophy descriptions name Chapters 1-4 plus a final mission. [S1]
disagreements.b: PowerPyx's roadmap describes the story as 5 chapters taking 60-80 hours. [S3]
disagreements.call: This guide follows the trophy descriptions (Ch. 1-4 + finale) and flags the difference; the roadmap order is the same either way.
disagreements.topic: How many chapters does the story have?

disagreements.a: Exophase and PSNProfiles list 28 hidden trophies. [S1][S2]
disagreements.b: GTA Spotter counts 26 trophies that spoil the story or are hidden. [S6]
disagreements.call: 28 is the tracker count used here; the 2-trophy gap is story trophies that are hidden on PSN but named in some lists.

disagreements.a: PowerPyx and KeenGamer estimate about 200 hours at difficulty 4/10. [S3][S5]
disagreements.call: This guide uses about 200 hours and 4/10, the two-source figure; treat 100 hours as the fast end, not the plan.

disagreements.a: PSNProfiles lists a 500 target for Actions Speak Louder. [S2]
disagreements.b: The official description only says 'Choices made (for better or worse)' and names nothing countable. [S1]
disagreements.call: UNRESOLVED: no source pins down what the 500 counts. This guide says so instead of guessing.
The May 2026 date was superseded; every date in this guide uses the real launch.

disagreements.a: The official list names it 'Strangers & Freaks'. [S1][S2]
disagreements.b: GTA Six Insider's table prints 'Stranger & Freaks'. [S7]
disagreements.call: Official spelling wins; the other is a typo in that list.

title: Leonida Platinum Guide v2 — GTA VI trophy guide & tracker

trophies.answer: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum pops on its own. [S1]
trophies.guide: The platinum is the reward for everything else, so there is no separate task to do for it. PowerPyx rates the whole run 4 out of 10 difficulty and about 200 hours, with 100% completion the longest single demand.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies; this one unlocks automatically with the last of them. [S1]
Work the roadmap in order: story first, then strangers and side stories, then activities and exploration, then collectibles and cleanup. [S3]
Plan on about 200 hours in total; the 100% completion checklist alone is roughly half of it. [S3]
tips: If a trophy below looks missable, do it when it appears: there is no mission replay. [S3]

trophies.answer: Finish the story mission Gone Fishing. [S1]
trophies.guide: This is a story trophy: it pops when the mission ends, with nothing extra to find or collect. Fishing is introduced in this mission, so the prompts it teaches are the same ones the fishing challenge trophy uses later.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Play the story until the mission Gone Fishing appears, then start it. [S1]
Follow the mission's fishing prompts: cast, wait for the bite, then reel as directed. [S5]
Finish the mission; the trophy pops at its end. [S1]
tips: No fishing skill or gear is needed beforehand; the mission supplies it. [S1]

trophies.answer: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. [S1]
trophies.guide: Chapter trophies pop when the chapter's last mission ends. Chapter 1 is also where the one possibly missable moment in the game sits, so the meditation note below matters more than the trophy itself.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play Chapter 1's missions in order until the chapter closes. [S1]
Before leaving Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation at Jason's house when Lucia offers it after the mission Down to Earth. [S5]
Finish the chapter; the trophy pops with its closing mission. [S1]
tips: PowerPyx flags that first meditation as the list's only potentially missable trophy moment. [S3]

trophies.answer: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. [S1]
trophies.guide: Another chapter trophy: keep playing the story and it pops on its own. Chapter 2 is also when the last meditation spot becomes reachable, once you can play as both characters after Coffee Break.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play Chapter 2's missions in order. [S1]
After the mission Coffee Break you can play as both characters, which the later meditation spots need. [S6]
Finish the chapter; the trophy pops with its closing mission. [S1]
tips: No side content is required for this one; the chapter's end is the trigger. [S1]

trophies.answer: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. [S1]
trophies.guide: The third chapter trophy. By now the map is opening up, so it is a good time to scan unfamiliar vehicles with the WAiNK app as you travel, since that progress counts toward the 100% checklist later.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play Chapter 3's missions in order. [S1]
While travelling between missions, scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app; that progress counts later. [S5]
Finish the chapter; the trophy pops with its closing mission. [S1]
tips: Scanning early saves a long cleanup: the checklist wants 200 of 277 base vehicles scanned. [S3]

trophies.answer: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. [S1]
trophies.guide: The last chapter trophy before the finale. PowerPyx's roadmap counts five chapters in total where the trophy descriptions name four plus a final mission; either way, this is the last chapter gate before the ending.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play Chapter 4's missions in order. [S1]
Clear any stranger or side missions you have open before the finale, while their givers are still around. [S3]
Finish the chapter; the trophy pops with its closing mission. [S1]
tips: See disagreement 2 in Sources: chapter counts differ between the list and PowerPyx. [S1][S3]

trophies.answer: Finish the final mission after Chapter 4. [S1]
trophies.guide: The story's gold trophy. It pops when the final mission ends, and the game then returns you to free-roam, where the 100% completion checklist becomes visible and everything needed for it is still reachable.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Finish Chapters 1-4 and every mission that leads to the finale. [S1]
Play the final mission to its end; there is no difficulty setting, so it plays the same for everyone. [S3]
After the credits, free-roam continues and the 100% checklist appears under Progress, then Stats. [S3]
tips: Save manually at the end of every chapter: missions cannot be replayed. [S6]

trophies.answer: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. [S1]
trophies.guide: A named-mission trophy: the mission's name is the whole requirement. These pop at the mission's end, so the only way to miss one is to stop playing the story.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Play the story until Breakfast Run appears, then start it. [S1]
Complete the mission's objectives as they are given. [S1]
Finish the mission; the trophy pops at its end. [S1]
tips: Mission trophies need no gold medal and no extra objective. [S3]

trophies.answer: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. [S1]
trophies.guide: A named-mission trophy for the cartel heist. Heists in this game are story beats, not the repeatable bank jobs the robbery trophies count, so finishing the mission is the whole job.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Play the story until The Cartel Heist appears, then start it. [S1]
Complete the heist's objectives as they are given. [S1]
Finish the mission; the trophy pops at its end. [S1]
tips: Do not confuse this story heist with the 5 bank vaults of Maximum Withdrawal. [S1]

trophies.answer: Finish the story mission Child's Play. [S1]
trophies.guide: A named-mission trophy: finishing Child's Play is the whole requirement. The description lists no time limit, no extra objective and no collectible, so play the mission normally and the trophy follows.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Play the story until Child's Play appears, then start it. [S1]
Complete the mission's objectives as they are given. [S1]
Finish the mission; the trophy pops at its end. [S1]
tips: Mission trophies are unmissable in the story flow; focus on finishing. [S1]

trophies.answer: Finish the story mission Headliners. [S1]
trophies.guide: A named-mission trophy for Headliners. The description names only the mission, so there is nothing to prepare beyond playing it through to the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Play the story until Headliners appears, then start it. [S1]
Complete the mission's objectives as they are given. [S1]
Finish the mission; the trophy pops at its end. [S1]
tips: If a checkpoint fails, retry from the pause menu rather than restarting. [S1]

trophies.answer: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. [S1]
trophies.guide: A named-mission trophy set at VCIA, the Vice City airport. The mission's name is the requirement; expect vehicle and on-foot action around the airport grounds, and keep a fast vehicle in mind for the escape.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Play the story until VCIA Takedown appears, then start it. [S1]
Complete the mission's objectives around the airport. [S1]
Finish the mission; the trophy pops at its end. [S1]
tips: Airport missions mix driving and shooting; keep a fast vehicle nearby. [S1]

trophies.answer: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. [S1]
trophies.guide: A named-mission trophy for Operation Savage Glory. The name points at a large-scale operation, so expect heavy combat and take the mission in stages rather than rushing its objectives.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Play the story until Operation Savage Glory appears, then start it. [S1]
Complete the mission's objectives as they are given. [S1]
Finish the mission; the trophy pops at its end. [S1]
tips: Stock armour and a good rifle before big combat missions. [S1]

trophies.answer: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist. [S3]
trophies.guide: The longest trophy in the game and the hardest by every source. The checklist only appears after the story, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, but progress made during the story already counts. It is closer to 60% true completion: you need every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest, but only 70 of the 80 challenges and 200 of 277 base vehicles scanned.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story; the 100% checklist then appears under Progress, then Stats. [S3]
Work the checklist category by category: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret quests must be complete. [S3]
Fill the partial counts: 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, and 70 of 80 challenges. [S3]
Check the percentage after each category and mop up whatever is still short. [S3]
tips: PowerPyx calls this the hardest trophy; start its counts during the story, not after. [S3]

trophies.answer: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida. [S1]
trophies.guide: A long grind: 250 stunts means 250 jumps and trick landings. Fold it into normal travel instead of grinding it in one sitting — whenever you pass a stunt jump, take it rather than driving around it.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Find stunt jumps and ramps while exploring Leonida. [S1]
Hit each one at speed and land it cleanly to count it. [S1]
Use the tracker's counter to hold your running total out of 250. [S2]
Repeat until the counter reaches 250. [S2]
tips: A fast, stable vehicle lands jumps more reliably than the fastest one. [S1]

trophies.answer: Play one session of each of the 9 activity types. [S1]
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: A sampler trophy: one session of each activity type, with no win required. The nine types are the game's activities — racing, shooting range, fishing, arcade games, drone races and the rest — and the trophy pops when the ninth type is tried.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Open the activities list in the game. [S1]
Play one session of an activity type; finishing is enough, winning is not required. [S1]
Work through the remaining types one by one. [S1]
The trophy pops after the ninth type is tried. [S2]
tips: Pair this with the other activity trophies so one session counts twice. [S1]

trophies.answer: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. [S1]
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: The hardest activity trophy: every one of the 42 range challenges needs a gold-medal score. Accuracy and speed both matter, and each challenge is built around a particular weapon, so learn the layout first and use the weapon the challenge expects.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit a shooting range and open its challenge list. [S1]
Play a challenge until you earn its gold medal. [S1]
Use the weapon the challenge is built around; a familiar gun beats a powerful one. [S1]
Repeat across all 42 challenges; the tracker holds your gold count. [S2]
tips: The 100% checklist also needs every shooting range done, so this feeds A Long Road too. [S3]

trophies.answer: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. [S1]
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Fourteen locations, fourteen drone races, fourteen wins. Drone races reward smooth flying and clean lines through the gates more than raw speed, so learn a course's turns before pushing hard on it.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find a Top Fun Drone Race location. [S1]
Race it and win; fly the racing line, not the shortest line, because the gates decide it. [S1]
Move to the next location and win there too. [S1]
Repeat until all 14 locations are won; the tracker holds the count. [S2]
tips: The 100% checklist needs every drone race done as well. [S3]

trophies.answer: Win 20 different races. [S1]
trophies.guide: The word different does the work here: winning the same race twenty times does not count. You need victories on twenty distinct race events, so vary the race types and locations and use the vehicle class each race suits best.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Enter races across different locations and types. [S1]
Win each one; a win on a new race adds to the counter. [S1]
Vary street, off-road and water events so every win is a different race. [S1]
Keep going until 20 different races are won. [S2]
tips: A slower, grippy car often wins more races than the fastest one. [S1]

trophies.answer: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. [S1]
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal is a fishing rival you meet through the fishing activity. Play the fishing challenges until one pits you against him, then out-fish him: the right bait, the right spot and steady reeling beat rushing.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Play fishing challenges to reach the one against Cal. [S1]
Match the bait and spot the challenge hints at. [S5]
Reel steadily and beat Cal's score. [S1]
The trophy pops when the challenge ends in your favour. [S1]
tips: Fishing is about patience: a steady reel beats a frantic one. [S5]

trophies.answer: Play one arcade game through to its end. [S1]
trophies.guide: The easiest trophy on the list: find an arcade machine, start a game, and play it to completion. Any arcade game counts, so pick the one you enjoy most — or the shortest one if you only want the trophy.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade machine in the game world. [S1]
Start an arcade game. [S1]
Play it through to its end; the trophy pops on completion. [S1]
Any arcade game counts, so the shortest one is the fastest route. [S1]
tips: This also counts as one of the nine activity types for Master of None. [S1]

trophies.answer: Finish Andy's final mission. [S1]
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy is one of the stranger characters with a mission strand; his quests are Lucia-only, so play them as Lucia. Work through his missions as they appear and the trophy pops at the end of the last one.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Meet Andy and play his missions as they appear. [S1]
Andy's strand is Lucia-only, so switch to Lucia for his missions. [S6]
Complete his final mission; the trophy pops at its end. [S1]
tips: Side strands unlock as the story advances; check the map for new markers between missions. [S3]

trophies.answer: Finish Kenton's final mission. [S1]
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton is another stranger with a mission strand across Leonida. Play each of his missions in order and the trophy pops at the end of the last one; the name hints at least one water-based mission in the chain.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Meet Kenton and play his missions as they appear. [S1]
Play the chain in order, including any boat missions. [S1]
Complete his final mission; the trophy pops at its end. [S1]
tips: Finish a strand's missions soon after they appear so you do not lose track of them. [S1]

trophies.answer: Finish Billy's final mission. [S1]
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand is another side chain across Leonida, and the name points at bikes and solo riding. Play his missions in order and the trophy pops when the last one ends.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Meet Billy and play his missions as they appear. [S1]
Keep a good bike handy for his vehicle-themed missions. [S1]
Complete his final mission; the trophy pops at its end. [S1]
tips: A strand's final mission is usually its hardest, so go in prepared. [S1]

trophies.answer: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands. [S1]
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Strangers appear as markers on the map; each one starts a short chain of missions. You need eight full strands finished, so do not just start them — see each one through to its final mission. The named side characters count toward the eight, so their trophies feed this one.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Find stranger markers on the map and start their strands. [S1]
Play each strand to its final mission. [S1]
Finish a strand before starting three more, so none gets forgotten. [S1]
Repeat until 8 strands are complete; the tracker holds the count. [S2]
tips: See disagreement 7: one list misprints the name as 'Stranger & Freaks'. [S7]

trophies.answer: Finish Randy's final mission. [S1]
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's chain is one of the stranger strands; the name points at supply runs, so expect delivery-style missions in it. Play his missions in order and the trophy pops at the end of the last one.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Meet Randy and play his missions as they appear. [S1]
Play the chain in order, including any delivery missions. [S1]
Complete his final mission; the trophy pops at its end. [S1]
tips: Delivery missions reward a sturdy vehicle and a direct route over speed. [S1]

trophies.answer: Finish Tyrone's final mission. [S1]
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand is another stranger chain across Leonida, and his quests are Jason-only. Play his missions in order as Jason and the trophy pops when the last one ends.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Meet Tyrone and play his missions as they appear. [S1]
Tyrone's strand is Jason-only, so switch to Jason for his missions. [S6]
Complete his final mission; the trophy pops at its end. [S1]
tips: A strand's final mission is a good place to spend your best gear. [S1]

trophies.answer: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida, starting with the Chapter 1 balcony. [S3]
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eighteen meditation spots in ten locations, and the only trophy every source calls potentially missable: the first meditation, at Jason's house, can only be done in Chapter 1, when Lucia offers it on the balcony after the mission Down to Earth. The last spot only opens once you can play as both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Meditate at every spot you find as you go, rather than leaving them for later.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, look for Lucia at Jason's house in the morning and accept her balcony meditation. [S5]
After Coffee Break in Chapter 2 you can play as both characters, which the later spots need. [S6]
Visit the remaining scenic spots — overlooks, beaches, parks — and meditate at each. [S8]
Repeat until all 18 spots are done; the tracker holds the count. [S2]
tips: PowerPyx: this is the list's only possibly missable trophy, and only as a maybe. [S3]

trophies.answer: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. [S1]
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret is a stranger who asks you to hunt a specific rare animal, and his quests are Jason-only. Find his strand, learn which animal he wants, then track it down: approach quietly, use a scoped rifle, and follow the trail rather than chasing noisily.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Meet Bret and take his hunting request. [S1]
Learn which unique animal he names. [S1]
Track it in its area — Bret's quests are Jason-only, so play as Jason. [S6]
Hunt it cleanly and finish the strand. [S1]
tips: The 100% checklist also needs every Bret quest done. [S3]

trophies.answer: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. [S1]
trophies.guide: Cards are hidden around Leonida in sets, and you need three full sets. There are fifteen complete sets in the game, so you can finish the three easiest ones and leave the rest; pick up cards whenever you see them during other activities, and save a dedicated sweep for the last few cards of each set.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Collect cards wherever you find them in the world. [S1]
Note which set each card belongs to, so you know which sets are closest to done. [S1]
Finish every card in a set to complete it. [S1]
Complete 3 sets in total; there are 15 sets, so pick the easiest three. [S5]
tips: Grab cards during normal play; a dedicated hunt at the end is much shorter that way. [S1]

trophies.answer: Use WAiNK at 100 different locations. [S1]
trophies.guide: WAiNK is the in-game app you use to scan and tag places; the trophy wants 100 different locations, so variety is the point. Use it at every new place you visit — landmarks, beaches, neighbourhoods — and the counter climbs on its own. Scanning vehicles with the same app feeds the 100% checklist too.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Travel to a new location in Leonida. [S1]
Use WAiNK there to count it. [S1]
Move on to the next new place; repeats do not count. [S1]
Repeat until 100 locations are counted; the tracker holds the count. [S2]
tips: Do this alongside exploration and meditation spots: one trip, three counters. [S1]

trophies.answer: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges. [S3]
trophies.guide: Challenges are small optional objectives spread across the activities — racing, shooting, fishing, exploring — and the game holds eighty of them in eight groups of ten. You only need fifty, so take the easy ones first and skip the hardest; the 100% checklist wants seventy, so this trophy comes on the way to that.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Play activities and take the challenges they offer. [S1]
Complete each challenge you attempt; easy ones first to build the counter fast. [S1]
There are 80 challenges in 8 groups of 10, and you need 50 of them. [S6]
Keep going until 50 are complete; the tracker holds the count. [S2]
tips: Pair this with the activity trophies so the same play counts twice. [S1]

trophies.answer: With your partner, lose a 4-star wanted level and escape. [S1]
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: A co-op moment: you need a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you, then you have to lose it. Do not fight the police head-on — break line of sight, get out of the search area, and stay hidden until the wanted level clears. This is one of the flagged one-time moments: it needs the right situation, so attempt it when it appears.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Reach a 4-star wanted level with your partner present. [S1]
Break line of sight and leave the search area. [S1]
Stay hidden until the wanted level clears and you have escaped. [S1]
tips: MISSABLE: attempt this when the chance appears; there is no mission replay. [S3]

trophies.answer: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing the wanted level. [S1]
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: The trick is the phrase 'without losing your Wanted Level': you must keep the heat on through all three robberies, so do not escape the police between shops. Plan a route with three shops close together, rob each in turn, and keep moving.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Find three shops close together on your route. [S1]
Rob the first shop with your partner, keeping the wanted level. [S1]
Rob the second and third shops back-to-back without losing the heat. [S1]
tips: MISSABLE: attempt this when your partner is with you and shops are near. [S1]

trophies.answer: Discover 100 different vehicles. [S1]
trophies.guide: Discovering means finding a vehicle type you have not seen before — driving past it, getting in, or spotting it in the world. Explore the whole state and try different areas: city streets, highways, countryside and the coast all hold different vehicles. Scanning with the WAiNK app also feeds the 100% checklist, which wants 200 of 277 base vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Explore different areas of Leonida. [S1]
Spot and approach vehicle types you have not seen before. [S1]
Scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app as you travel; the checklist wants 200 of 277 scanned. [S3]
Keep discovering until the counter reaches 100. [S2]
tips: Variety is the key: a new district usually means new vehicles. [S1]

trophies.answer: Drop 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. [S1]
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the game's slow-down aiming mode. Wait for a firefight with at least five enemies nearby, let them group up, then trigger it and work through them quickly with a high-damage weapon before the window ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a firefight with at least 5 enemies close together. [S1]
Wait for the enemies to group up before activating anything. [S1]
Trigger Combat Focus and take down 5 enemies before it ends. [S1]
If fewer than five drop, try again at the next crowded fight. [S1]
tips: One at a time wastes the window; group them first. [S1]

trophies.answer: Leave VCIA, the airport, by an unscheduled departure. [S1]
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy with a deliberately vague description: it points at leaving the airport in an unplanned way, most likely by taking an aircraft without going through the normal departure. The exact trigger is not pinned down by the description, so this guide says so plainly instead of guessing a specific gate or runway.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to VCIA, the Vice City airport. [S1]
Find an aircraft you can board. [S1]
Make your unscheduled departure and leave the airport. [S1]
tips: MISSABLE: try this the first time you are at the airport. [S1]

trophies.answer: Get into a Rhino tank and make it count. [S1]
trophies.guide: The description is a joke about Rhinos — the game's tanks — and a hidden trophy, so the exact trigger is not spelled out. The sensible reading is that it involves a Rhino tank: drive one, survive in one, or take one on. When a story or side moment puts you near a Rhino, drive it and see if the trophy pops; this guide does not invent a specific step the description never states.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Find a Rhino tank during play. [S1]
Drive it or complete the moment involving it. [S1]
If it does not pop, keep the trophy in mind for the next tank moment. [S1]
tips: MISSABLE: tank moments are rare, so act when one appears. [S1]

trophies.answer: Rob a jewelry store without anyone spotting you. [S1]
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Stealth is the whole requirement: get in, take the goods, and get out without any guard, camera or alarm spotting you. Move slowly, use cover, and watch a full patrol cycle before you act. If you are detected, the attempt fails — leave, lose the heat, and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Find a jewelry store you can rob. [S1]
Enter quietly and avoid guards and cameras. [S1]
Take the goods and leave without being detected. [S1]
tips: MISSABLE: attempt it when a jewelry store robbery is available. [S1]

trophies.answer: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape the police after each one. [S1]
trophies.guide: Bank vault robberies are the big heist-style jobs: get in, crack the vault, grab the cash, and escape the police response. Each vault counts only if you escape, so the getaway matters as much as the robbery — plan the escape route before you start. The 100% checklist wants eight bank vault robberies, so this trophy comes on the way to that.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Find a bank vault robbery opportunity. [S1]
Rob the vault and take the cash. [S1]
Escape the police to count it. [S1]
Repeat until 5 vaults are robbed and escaped. [S2]
tips: Plan the getaway first: a fast car parked nearby beats improvising under fire. [S1]

trophies.answer: Rob an armored truck and escape the police. [S1]
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks travel the roads of Leonida; stop one, get its cargo, and escape the police response. The escape is part of the trophy, so do not count it done until the wanted level clears. A quiet road and a fast getaway car make the job much easier than a busy street.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find an armored truck on the road. [S1]
Stop it and take its cargo. [S1]
Escape the police to count the robbery. [S1]
Have your getaway car facing the escape route before you strike. [S1]
tips: Pick a quiet stretch of road so the police response has further to travel. [S1]

trophies.answer: Visit all 52 areas of Leonida. [S1]
trophies.guide: The game tracks 52 areas, and you need to visit them all — cities, towns, beaches, swamps and countryside. Work through the map region by region instead of wandering: clear one area fully, then move to the next. Combine this with the meditation spots, the WAiNK locations and the vehicle discoveries so one trip counts for several trophies.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Open the map and note which areas are still unvisited. [S1]
Travel to each unvisited area. [S1]
Clear the map region by region; wandering leaves gaps. [S1]
Keep going until all 52 areas are explored. [S2]
tips: Fly or drive the coast road to pick up the far-flung areas early. [S1]

trophies.answer: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs. [S1]
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Every gang runs illegal operations somewhere in Leonida; you need to rob one operation per gang, all nine. Learn which gang controls which area, hit one operation there, and move on to the next gang's territory. The 100% checklist wants 39 gang operations in total, so this trophy is the start of that grind, not the end of it.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Find an illegal operation run by a gang. [S1]
Rob it. [S1]
Repeat for each of the other 8 gangs until all 9 are hit. [S1]
Keep notes on which gangs you have already hit; nine is easy to lose count of. [S1]
tips: Go in prepared: gang turf fights back. [S1]

trophies.answer: Order a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. [S1]
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A quiet one-time moment: go to a bar or spot on Ocean Beach with a view, order a cocktail, and enjoy it. It is missable because it needs that specific place and moment, so do it the first time you are on Ocean Beach with the chance to sit and drink.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to Ocean Beach. [S1]
Find a spot with a view where you can order a cocktail. [S1]
Enjoy the cocktail there. [S1]
tips: MISSABLE: do this on your first visit to Ocean Beach. [S1]

trophies.answer: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom. [S1]
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: A one-time stunt moment: get into a vehicle inside a showroom and smash your way out through the glass, in classic GTA style. The description names the place plainly, so drive in when the chance appears and make your exit through the front.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Go to a vehicle showroom. [S1]
Get into a vehicle inside it. [S1]
Smash your way out through the glass. [S1]
tips: MISSABLE: do this when you are next at a showroom. [S1]

trophies.answer: Bowl a frame at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. [S1]
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: A quiet moment at the bowling alley: go to the Kolt & Associates alley, bowl a frame, and follow through. The description names the place, so this one is easy to plan — and it pairs naturally with the melee drive-by trophy below.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. [S1]
Bowl a frame there. [S1]
Follow through to the end of the frame. [S1]
tips: MISSABLE: do this when you are next at the alley. [S1]

trophies.answer: Earn a partnership with mass appeal — the description stays vague on purpose. [S1]
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy whose description is deliberately cryptic: 'a partnership with mass appeal'. The description does not name a place, a person or an action, so no source pins down the trigger. The honest reading is a co-op or partner moment with a wide audience — try partner activities and public moments, and treat any specific claim you read elsewhere as unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Play partner activities with your co-op partner. [S1]
Try public, high-profile moments together. [S1]
If it does not pop, keep the trophy in mind for the next partner moment. [S1]
tips: MISSABLE: the description names nothing countable, so do partner moments when they appear. [S1]

trophies.answer: Make 500 choices — but what the 500 counts is not pinned down by any source. [S2]
trophies.guide: The honest answer is that nobody outside the tracker knows what this counts. PSNProfiles lists a target of 500, but the official description only says 'Choices made (for better or worse)' and names nothing countable. The likely reading is choices or interactions across the game, made naturally as you play; this guide refuses to invent a specific farm for a number no source explains.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Play the game and make choices as they come; there is no confirmed list of what counts. [S1]
PSN tracks 500 of something here, but no source says of what. [S2]
Keep playing normally and watch the counter; do not grind a guessed action. [S1]
See disagreement 5 in Sources: this one is unresolved. [S1][S2]
tips: UNRESOLVED: if a later guide pins the 500 down, this guide will be updated. [S1][S2]

trophies.answer: Fail once, then succeed on the second try. [S1]
trophies.guide: A cryptic hidden trophy: 'second time's the charm'. The plain reading is that something must fail first and succeed on the second attempt. The description names no activity, so no source pins the trigger down — treat it as a moment to watch for when an attempt fails, then try the same thing again at once.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: When an attempt at something fails, try the same thing again right away. [S1]
Succeed on the second try. [S1]
If it does not pop, keep the pattern in mind for the next failed attempt. [S1]
tips: MISSABLE: retry at once after a failure; a later retry may not be the same moment. [S1]

trophies.answer: Trigger the strange event the description only hints at. [S1]
trophies.guide: The most cryptic description on the list: 'What the hell just happened?' It points at a surprising or strange in-game event, but names no place, person or action, so no source pins the trigger down. The honest advice is to play normally and watch for odd moments — easter eggs, rare encounters, strange scenes — and check the trophy after each one.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Play normally and watch for strange or surprising events. [S1]
When something odd happens, check whether the trophy popped. [S1]
Keep an eye out for easter eggs and rare encounters as you explore. [S1]
tips: MISSABLE: rare moments may only happen once, so pay attention when the game surprises you. [S1]

trophies.answer: Knock bowling pins over with a melee drive-by. [S1]
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A drive-by with a melee weapon, aimed at bowling pins. Get a vehicle, arm a melee weapon, and drive past the pins swinging — the pins need to fall from the drive-by, not from bowling normally. This pairs with the bowling alley visit above, so do both on the same trip.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Go to a bowling alley with pins set up. [S1]
Get in a vehicle and arm a melee weapon. [S1]
Drive past the pins and knock them over with the melee drive-by. [S1]
tips: MISSABLE: do this while you are at the alley for Let's Go Bowling. [S1]

trophies.answer: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. [S1]
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills are dirty money from robberies, and your contacts launder them into clean cash. Earn $250,000 through laundering in total — the robberies feed this trophy, so every vault, truck and gang operation you rob adds dirty money to wash.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Rob vaults, trucks and gang operations to earn Marked Bills. [S1]
Take the bills to your contacts to launder them. [S1]
Keep laundering after each robbery so the total climbs steadily. [S1]
Repeat until $250,000 has been laundered. [S2]
tips: This feeds off the robbery trophies: do the robberies first, launder as you go. [S1]

trophies.answer: Spend $100,000 across all shops. [S1]
trophies.guide: A spending trophy: $100,000 across all shops in total, not in one place. Weapons, ammo, clothes, food and vehicles all count, so it climbs naturally as you gear up for the late game. If it is short at the end, buy the most expensive items you still want rather than wasting money on things you will never use.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Buy weapons, ammo, clothes and gear as you play. [S1]
Spend across different shops, not just one. [S1]
Check the tracker total and top it up with big purchases at the end. [S2]
tips: Big-ticket items at the end are the fastest way to close a short gap. [S1]

trophies.answer: Buy every garage property. [S1]
trophies.guide: Garages are properties you buy to store vehicles, and this trophy wants all eight of them. They cost money, so this one is really a money trophy in disguise: save up, buy each garage as you can afford it, and the trophy pops with the eighth purchase.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Find the garage properties for sale around Leonida. [S1]
Buy each one as you can afford it. [S1]
Purchase all 8 garages; the trophy pops with the last one. [S2]
tips: Save for garages after the big story payouts land. [S1]

trophies.answer: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. [S1]
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app is where you register vehicles you find. Discover a vehicle, open the app, and register it; ten registrations is the target. This pairs with the vehicle discovery trophy, so register every new vehicle you find instead of leaving them for a cleanup sweep.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Discover a vehicle in the world. [S1]
Open the Scooter Bros app and register it. [S1]
Repeat for new vehicles until 10 are registered. [S2]
tips: Register as you discover: it feeds Whip It Good at the same time. [S1]
